title: Computer Networking Basics
description: A quiz covering fundamental concepts of computer networks, topologies, cables, and devices
author: Khemzie

questions.text: Which of the following best explains the primary purpose of computer networking?
options: To enable communication and resource sharing between devices

questions.text: Which cable type is MOST resistant to electromagnetic interference?

options: Transmits data as light and supports very high speeds

questions.text: Which device forwards data only to the intended recipient instead of broadcasting to all devices?

questions.text: A Wireless LAN (WLAN) differs from a traditional LAN because it:
options: Uses radio signals instead of physical cables
